line: Tell someone you believe in them.
paragraph: A team of volunteers has been working to save the rosella spider orchid, one of many Australian orchids at risk of disappearing. They set up a nursery at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Victoria. When they began, twice as many orchids grew there as were thought to remain in the wild. Their careful work gave the flowers a stable home. Someone believed this small fragile thing was worth the trouble.

seed.summary: There are many orchids at risk of extinction in Australia alone, few more than this rosella spider orchid.
